services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: The Equifit assessment is the foundation of Personal Training at Equinox, complimentary for every Member. It collects biometrics and fitness data to inform your training plan. Because real data drives real results. Our team pairs you with a COACH who aligns with your fitness goals, personal preferences, and the expertise you need. Your data doesn't lie. Your COACH translates every biometric, every benchmark into a precision-engineered training plan built for your body. This is where science meets intention, and where your results begin. Meet with your COACH and start your Personal Training journey. Your first session is complimentary when you join

services.name: Pilates Rise
services.desc: At its core, Studio Pilates tightens what’s loose and loosens what’s tight. By working evenly with subtle moves, no muscles are ever over or under-trained, creating balance in the body. We offer a completely authentic Pilates experience, created by Joseph Pilates. Each studio houses several pieces of unique equipment. With over 500 exercises, you move against springs and your own body weight, creating resistance for a highly targeted workout. Keep your in-club results going with Virtual Pilates-challenging mat training at home. You’ll connect live with one of our certified instructors and be guided one-on-one through slow, controlled movements that build strength, flexibility, and mobility.
